one_liner.zh: 在 Linux 桌面显示随 DSH 会话状态变化的透明悬浮宠物
one_liner.en: A transparent Linux desktop pet that reflects DSH session activity

local: Linux with X11 or XWayland, GTK3/PyGObject, GdkPixbuf and Python 3 are required; xdotool enables window hints.
Reads local DSH session event files and writes configuration under the DSH home directory.
